pictures.observed: Low angle porch corner: white columns and shallow bracketed/arched lintels support an enclosed upper gallery with rectangular dark wood window grilles. Cream wall panels carry green,rust and ochre painted motifs. Broad dark red/green eaves beneath a tiled roof. A pale stone minaret has a projecting pale balcony and pointed cap. Fine floral painting and calligraphy are not copied.

pictures.observed: Painted side wall with four stacked rows of framed cream panels;green,ochre and rust rosette/star centers. Lower rectangular grilled windows and an upper row of narrow arched patterned fields. Low brown tiled hip roof with a broad eave;stone minaret shaft and lower balcony visible,tip cropped in this picture. The two pictures together guide the tower/roof vocabulary;neither establishes precise dimensions.
